title: Read the job spec
spec: Add src/payee/spec.ts: readSpec(offer, notes: { get(ns, key) }): Promise<string|null>. If job.context matches ^/kv/<ns>/<key>$ fetch the note (errors → null). Otherwise if job.context is present and at least 12 chars, return it as the inline spec, appending " | full spec: <note>" only when the text names a /kv/ path. No job or no readable context → null: the harness never invents work.
done: Pointer, inline and empty contexts resolve to the expected spec strings against an in-memory note store.
